2013_056_111213mtg.paragraph: Troy School District's Board of Education met in regular session at 7:00 PM on November 12, 2013 at Athens High School, 4333 John R, and the packet assembles the agenda, minutes of the October 1 regular meeting and the October 15 special meeting and workshop, the August and September 2013 Treasurer's Reports with their complete check registers, ACH/P-Card and wire listings, and fund-by-fund budget reports, plus personnel, summer tax and audit items. The centerpiece is the 2012-2013 audit presented by Teresa Pollock of Plante Moran, which reported General Fund revenue of $130,643,398 against expenditures of $131,851,755 and an ending General Fund balance of $22,070,236 at June 30, 2013.

**Meeting and agenda**
Troy School District Board of Education regular meeting, 7:00 PM, November 12, 2013, Athens High School, 4333 John R, Troy, MI 48085; district offices at 4400 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098, 248.823.4000. Meetings cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) Mondays and Wednesdays at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m. and posted at http://vimeo.com/troyschools. Public participation is limited to one-half hour for agenda items and one-half hour for non-agenda items, three minutes per speaker. Agenda items: recognition of the CAPE (Citizens and Parents for Education) Steering Committee for Bond 2013 — Tracy Heikka, Jen Hilzinger, Dave Lambert and Raj Thangamuthu; a consent agenda of prior minutes and the August and September Treasurer's Reports; personnel considerations and a negotiations report; 2014 summer tax collections; the 2012-2013 audit report and its acceptance; a 2013 Bond Election Review & Timeline; and a closed session on negotiations.

**Minutes carried on the consent agenda**
October 1, 2013 regular meeting (President Philippart presiding, roughly 200 in the audience): Resolution 13-086 honored forty-six 2013-2014 National Merit Scholarship semifinalists; 13-0087 approved September minutes; 13-088 issued a probationary contract to Zachary Rondot; 13-089 seated the 2013-2014 Sex Education Advisory Board; 13-090 adopted Board committee assignments; 13-091 authorized closed session under Public Act 267, Section 8(c). Thirteen speakers addressed teacher contract negotiations; the meeting adjourned at 11:36 p.m. October 15 special meeting adopted 13-092 (Women of Tomorrow Mentor & Scholarship Program memo of understanding, 6-0, Miletti absent) and 13-093. The October 15 workshop heard Plante Moran auditors and Gallagher Benefit Services on national health care reform.

Encumbrances stood at $5,612,143 and available budget at $107,487,564. Excess revenue over expenditures is shown as 441,888, with fund balance of 20,989,250 at September 1, 2013 and $21,431,138 projected at June 30, 2014.

**Business items**
The summer tax resolution continues collection of one-half of school property taxes, including debt service, beginning with 2014, under 1976 P.A. 451, with collection expenses negotiable under MCLA 380.1612 and notice to the City of Troy before January 1, 2014. Personnel item 6.A recommends probationary contracts for Caitlin Goike (.5 FTE Resource Room, Larson Middle School) and Ashleigh Horler (1.0 FTE Resource Room, Troy High School). Item 8.B is the Plante Moran audit presentation; 8.C asks the Board to accept the audited 2013 financial statements.

**Document and meeting.** Board of Education packet for the Troy School District (Oakland County, Michigan) regular meeting of November 12, 2013, 7:00 PM at Athens High School, 4333 John R, Troy, MI 48085. District offices: 4400 Livernois, Troy, Michigan 48098, 248.823.4000, www.troy.k12.mi.us; Business Department 248-823-4022. Meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) Mondays and Wednesdays at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m. and streamed at http://vimeo.com/troyschools; public comment is one-half hour for agenda items and one-half hour for non-agenda items, three minutes per speaker. Item 2.A recognizes the CAPE (Citizens and Parents for Education) Steering Committee for Bond 2013 — Tracy Heikka, Jen Hilzinger, Dave Lambert and Raj Thangamuthu. The agenda lists four consent items while the consent page letters only three, dropping the October 15 special-meeting minutes.

**Minutes, October 1, 2013 regular meeting.** President Philippart opened at 7:00 p.m. with Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Miletti, Schmidt and Underwood present, Superintendent Fowler and administrators Birmingham, Keeling, Machesky, Mull, Rajter, Washington and Witt, and approximately 200 audience members. Student representatives Michaela Smith (Athens) and Needa Toofanny (International Academy – East) reported; Patty Durell represents Troy High. Resolution 13-086 honored forty-six 2013-2014 National Merit Scholarship semifinalists, noting more than one million entrants from some 22,000 high schools, only 16,000 semifinalists nationally, and PSAT scores in the top one and one-half percent; adopted 7-0 on a motion by Mrs. Edmunds supported by Mr. Hauff, with a reception October 23rd at Athens. Thirteen speakers addressed teacher contract negotiations, including TEA bargaining team members Cindy Shankin and Diane Loucks. Resolution 13-0087 approved September 3 and September 17, 2013 minutes, 7-0; 13-088 issued a probationary contract to new hire Zachary Rondot, 7-0. Jasen Witt, Assistant Superintendent of Human Resources, reported mediated sessions September 26th and October 1st, a full economic offer with "some movement but not enough," a union offer tied to per-pupil funding, and a next session October 4th. Resolution 13-089 seated the Sex Education Advisory Board under co-chairs Amy Buchanan and Nicole Jenkins, with Mary McDermott (Troy High), Kevin Wilson (Boulan Park), Rev. David Huseltine of Big Beaver United Methodist Church, nurse Lois Winer of the Oakland Health Department, resident Diane Trombley and students Heather Turner and Dejan Jenkins. Anne Mull's professional development report cited the August 28th session and a focus on the bottom 30%; Dr. Rich Machesky reported that Troy School District had 48.8% of the senior class scoring a three or higher on an AP exam. Resolution 13-090 adopted committee assignments; the Superintendent's report noted the expectation that districts reach 85% of all students proficient by 2021/2022. Resolution 13-091 authorized closed session under the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(c), 7-0; the Board recessed 9:08 p.m., reconvened 9:13 p.m., adjourned 11:36 p.m. Secretary Paula Fleming submitted the minutes.

**Minutes, October 15, 2013 special meeting and workshop.** Special meeting at 5:00 p.m., Administration Building, Miletti absent, no audience. Resolution 13-092 approved the Women of Tomorrow Mentor & Scholarship Program memorandum of understanding for at-risk young women, 6-0; 13-093 authorized closed session on negotiations under Section 8(c), 6-0; recess 5:05 p.m., reconvene 5:08 p.m., adjournment 5:58 p.m. The 6:00 p.m. workshop, attended by three Plante Moran auditors and Gallagher Benefit Services representatives, covered the district audit and national health care reform, adjourning 8:19 p.m.

**Business and Other (8.A, 8.B, 8.C, 10.A, 11.A).** The annual summer tax resolution continues summer tax collections for the 2014-2015 fiscal year, invoking under 1976 P.A. 451, as amended, a levy of one-half of school property taxes including debt service beginning with 2014 and continuing until revoked, with notice to the City of Troy to be received before January 1, 2014 and collection expenses negotiable under MCLA 380.1612.
